title: You Successfully Stalked Us, Please Don't Do It Again.
summary: Matt Gray and Tom Scott review how viewers worked out where they watched the 2017 solar eclipse from, based on clues in their video. They go through the methods people used and how accurate the guesses were.
why: Used as an example of how effectively internet sleuths can geolocate someone from small details, in privacy and open-source-intelligence discussions.

quote.text: it is scary how accurately their location was found by Internet sleuths.
